message:
alyssa: Quick check — panel for SDE candidate tomorrow 10:30am PT. Who's taking notes and where's the Zoom/room? Also we need rubric link.

jon: I'm remote, can take notes if nobody objects. Zoom pls.

samir: I'll be on call for system design portion. Can we get the rubric for architecture vs infra clarified? The rubric has overlap.

maria: Assigned debrief owner should capture consensus + action items. I can be debrief owner unless someone else prefers.

alyssa: Thanks @maria — can you also post room/zoom in candidate thread? We use Zoom 123-456-789

kyle: Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 passcode: Redwood123

jon: Got it. Also note: candidate is in CET; they said 19:30 CET. Confirmed.

samir: For rubric: grade architecture (1-4), tradeoffs (1-4), coding (1-4). If coding borderline, mark for follow-up question.

alyssa: @samir can you paste the short rubric snippet we use? saves confusion.

samir: Sure:
```
Architecture: clarity, tradeoffs, decomposition (1-4)
Implementation: correctness, tests, edge-cases (1-4)
Communication: explanations + questions (1-4)
```

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Panel debrief template and rubric sent to #interviews-docs

maria: I'll take notes and run debrief. @alyssa can you add candidate ID and resume link?

alyssa: Added resume: https://drive.redwood/resumes/sde-123.pdf. Candidate ID 2026-SDE-87

kyle: Small ask — can we get mic/AV check at 10:15? I'll be in-person for room A2.

alyssa: Cool — thanks all. I'll post final thread with links + confirm panels 1 hour before.
